sentences.text:
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned APP for the State and the learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2.
2.

This application has been filed for quashing of the order dated 06.10.2020 passed in Amdabad P.S. Case No. 137 of 2019 by learned Special Judge cum ADJ-VII, Katihar by which cognizance was taken after differing with the police report under Sections 302, 201, 376, 120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
3.

After some arguments, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner prays for and is permitted to withdraw this application with liberty to raise all the grounds at the stage of discharge/ at an appropriate stage.
Accordingly, this application is dismissed as withdrawn.

Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.42210 of 2021(4) dt.03-02-2026 4.
